ns2:course.label: French Diction
ns2:course.description: French pronunciation applied to French vocal literature; class and individual clinical analysis and practice. To be taken with MUS 181. Prerequisite: At least one semester of French or equivalent required, sophomore standing in voice, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: At least one semester of French or equivalent required, sophomore standing in voice, or consent of instructor.
